title: Report of critical examination.
officialText:
The registered design professional shall submit a written report to the commissioner within 60 days of completing the critical examination, at least once during each five-year report filing cycle, as defined by rule of the department certifying the results of such critical examination as either safe, unsafe or safe with a repair and maintenance program. The report shall clearly document the condition of the exterior walls and appurtenances thereof and shall include a record of all significant deterioration, unsafe conditions and movement observed as well as a statement concerning the watertightness of the exterior surfaces. Such report must be signed and sealed by such registered design professional.

(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
